prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head turned about forty-five degrees to her right in a three-quarter view, her eyes still looking straight into the camera, one ear and the turned cheek clearly visible, and from this angle the full projection of her lips from her face is clearly visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Late 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Japanese woman — Japanese fresh natural beauty fair complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and natural skin tone, late 20s, a chic black lob with soft layers, extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: smudged black raccoon eyeliner ringing the eyes, jagged black eyeshadow shards at the outer corners, thick black lower lashes, thin bleached brows, glossy black lips with a deliberately ragged edge, odd-eyed with two clearly different lenses: her left eye has a vivid emerald-green coloured contact lens with a vertical slit cat-eye pupil, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, and her right eye has a bright turquoise coloured contact lens with a vertical slit cat-eye pupil, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, the two eye colours both bright and clearly different from each other, eyes wide and startled, unsure where to look, a deep blush spreading across the cheeks and nose, the lower lip lightly bitten, a flustered, embarrassed expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colour and finish follow her makeup and ignore any lip colour named here): lips inflated far beyond the fantasy limit: so tall that together they fill the whole space between the base of her nose and the tip of her small neat chin, the upper lip lifted so high that it nearly presses against the base of her nose, a plump heart-shaped bow with two razor-sharp towering peaks, the lower lip a gigantic, domed, glossy cushion, the whole pout projecting enormously far forward from her face like a sculpted doll mouth, the width of the mouth still in proportion to her face, every edge perfectly crisp and razor-sharp, so the lips are overwhelmingly the dominant feature of her face in this three-quarter view; mirror-glossy pink-nude with bright white highlights along the top of each lip and on the dome of the lower lip, perfectly symmetrical, sculpted and still beautiful, never duck-like, never smudged past the lip line; her nose: a very steep, sharply sculpted surgical nose: a knife-like bridge that rises steeply and sharply from the brow, a needle-pointed tip projecting well forward, and very narrow, tightly pinched nostril wings with thin, slit-like nostrils; her jawline and chin: a heart-shaped face: a wide forehead and high, full cheekbones narrowing in a smooth curve into a delicate, pointed, softly rounded chin like the tip of a heart. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about eighty-three in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; two small rings wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; two straight bars across the bridge of the nose, from just below the inner ends of the brows (well clear of the eyes) down to the middle of the nose, each with a gem cap at both ends; five small bar or rings through each eyebrow, all on the brow bone above the eyes and never on the eyelids; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the upper opening holding a gigantic multi-tier waterfall chandelier earring, a large classic round O-ring hoop in the lobe with three stacked tiers of marquise and teardrop gem drops cascading from it, each tier wider than the last, as wide as her palm and as long as her hand, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the lower opening holding one very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit fourteen pieces above the lobe: seven classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, four studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and three in the conch and tragus; ten small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; five small studs on each temple bone, well clear of the eyes; eight small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are punk in style: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are safety-pin shaped bars, sharp cone-spike studs and chunky chain-link rings. The left and right sides are balanced. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. The ornate earring and the weights hang side by side from the two openings without touching or hiding each other. All the ear weights hang from the bottom of the lower iron ring, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly five separate massive weights, each of a different shape and a different metal, all of them rough, hammered, matte and unpolished, each hanging on its own thick heavy chain of the same metal as the weight: on the left ear blackened cast iron a pyramid-shaped lump on a shortest chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a miniature anvil on a short chain, tarnished dark silver a square-sided cowbell on a medium chain, oxidized dark copper a barrel-shaped weight on a long chain, dull dark brass a cube-shaped block on a longer chain; on the right ear dark patinated bronze a barrel-shaped weight on a shortest chain, oxidized dark copper a round bell on a short chain, dull pewter-grey tin a hammer head on a medium chain, rough-cast matte yellow gold a cube-shaped block on a long chain, blackened cast iron a chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre on a longer chain. On each ear the lower iron ring carries its own column of 5 weights on chains of different lengths, staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid lump of metal at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, rough and matte and unpolished with no shine and no delicate or thin parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between two openings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel and chrome silver, spiked and studded, with no gemstones, while the hanging weights are always rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal in mixed materials (lead, tin, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass and iron), sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft key light from the front and slightly to the side on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
